initial_application: FHIR-32453 first set both AuditEvent.agent.type and Provenance.agent.type to example while the value set was being cleaned. Commit 760011453b then cleaned source/terminologies/valueset-participation-role-type.xml and changed AuditEvent.agent.type to preferred, but Provenance.agent.type remained at the older example strength.
additional_context: Provenance and AuditEvent are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current participation-role-type value set is narrow and matches the FHIR-32519 resolution. Other current resources reuse the same value set for different participant-function contexts and were not changed because FHIR-32519 was specifically about .agent.type in this issue family.
